dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Huh? Hired muscle in Liyue also moonlights doing artistic performance gigs?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "What's that called again... Uh, Wushou Dance?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Haha, if you spot one of our people taking part, there's no need to be surprised... After all, who doesn't enjoy that kind of lively, boisterous atmosphere?"
